strategyPoints: Tire wear is always a factor at Pocono. Managing those tires over a long stint on this abrasive surface will be crucial to success.
The length of the pit road here means that pit stops take a significant amount of time. A slow stop can ruin a driver's race.
Fuel strategy will also play a key role. Stretching a stint to gain track position could be a gamble worth taking.
With the long straights, aerodynamic efficiency is key. Teams will be looking to maximize their car's performance in clean air.
Track position is vital on this oval, making qualifying all the more important. Starting up front will be a huge advantage.
The pit window is relatively short here at Pocono, meaning teams will need to be decisive with their strategy calls.
Watch out for late-race cautions. A well-timed caution can completely change the complexion of the race.
Teams will be monitoring tire degradation closely, especially late in the race. Fresh tires could be the key to a late charge.

The temperature is climbing, which will increase tire wear and make the track even more challenging.
